inventory_definition: Every regular file in each locally-verified PyPI sdist and linux x86_64 wheel for 2.26.0, 2.26.1, 3.0.0, 3.0.1 and 3.0.2; each entry records archive path, SHA-256 and uncompressed byte size; directory entries are omitted. Other platform wheels stay registry-only and are not inventoried. Artifacts were not executed.
